description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [ATK, DEF, MAG and RES +30% (25s)] to all allies, grants [Attach Fire], [Awoken Fire], [Damage Cap +10000], [High Retaliate] and [Big Softie Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Fire
description.text: Fire abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Fire abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Attach Fire
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Fire damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Fire resistance +20%

description.name: High Retaliate
description.text: Evades PHY attacks, counters PHY attacks with an ability (PHY: single, 1.20 physical)

description.name: Big Softie Mode
description.text: Casts Flaming Soul Slash after another V ally uses an ability, removed after triggering four times, grants [Weakness +30% Boost 3] to all allies when removed

description.name: Weakness +30% Boost 3
description.text: Increases damage dealt by 30% when exploiting elemental weaknesses

description.name: Flaming Soul Slash
description.text: Four single attacks (0.73 each), 100% hit rate
